reproducer.actual: The consumers currently duplicate compatible but separate shape checks; mncs-test owns the checked-in schema while other repositories carry transport copies.
reproducer.command: Compare the plan validators and schemas in mncs-test, RAVEL, mncs-actions, and mncs-forge-mcp for the same mncs.verification-plan/1 artifact.
reproducer.expected: All consumers accept or reject the same bounded transport shape and preserve the same typed escalation vocabulary.

requiredBehavior: Publish one versioned family-owned verification-plan schema and validator, or a language-native equivalent, consumed by Ravel, mncs-test, Actions, Forge, and future Doctor integrations without duplicating semantic selection logic.
summary: The selective loop now has a working mncs.verification-plan/1 contract, but Ravel, mncs-test, Actions, and Forge each carry a boundary validator because the family has no shared canonical schema/validator package. Field drift can make a plan appear valid to one consumer and invalid to another.
title: No single family-owned verification-plan validator
